messages.author: 23b60abd2aad65e8
messages.subject: Server Broken
parts:
I am now getting this error, where I have made no changes to ui.R in my shiny-server/www/{app} directories - I updated the server to the latest shiny version, and sudo restarted it, but no luck
any ideas? 
Here is the error:

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in startAppDir(port = port) : Neither ui.R nor a www subdirectory was found in /var/shiny-server/www Calls: runApp -> startAppDir Execution halted

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Server Broken
parts:
It certainly could be--these files need to be accessible to the "shiny" user. Try running:

sudo chmod 755 /var/shiny-server/www
sudo chmod 644 /var/shiny-server/www/*

If that doesn't work, can you send along the output of:

sudo find /var/shiny-server/www

Thanks.
